description: Validate repository configuration when adding a new architectural layer whose directory path mapping was left blank.

change_context.other_context: A team updates the architecture configuration with a new layer entry without associating it with project directories, causing configuration loading to fail.

human_notes: Single: Requirement that every declared layer in architecture.json must map to one or more non-empty path prefixes (ref-archlint-001) governs layer declaration validation.

description: Define permitted import directions between architectural layers so that business logic components can depend on data access components.

change_context.other_context: Update layer dependency rules to authorize cross-layer imports from the application domain layer to underlying persistence layers.

human_notes: Single: Specification requiring each declared layer to explicitly define permitted target layers in Rules (ref-archlint-002) governs cross-layer dependency rules.

description: Determine which architectural layer owns a source file when multiple configured layer paths match its directory location.

change_context.other_context: Assign source files located within nested directory trees where both a general parent path and a specialized nested path are configured.

human_notes: Single: Rule assigning files to layers via longest matching path prefix with sorted tie-breaking (ref-archlint-003) governs hierarchical path classification.

description: Verify that an architectural decision document containing both descriptive context and formal dependency rules is recognized when scanning repository decisions.

change_context.other_context: A team introduces an architecture record with contextual explanation and structured boundary directives to ensure the decision participates in dependency checking.

human_notes: Single: Specification parsing executable directives from fenced blocks inside ADR markdown files while ignoring prose (ref-archlint-004) governs ADR constraint extraction.

description: Reconcile architectural dependency policy when a decision record restricts an import direction that the base configuration permits.

change_context.other_context: Determine how the effective ruleset handles a direct policy disagreement where configuration and an architectural record specify opposing rules for the same dependency.

human_notes: Single: Rule union and conflict-detection semantics treating an ADR deny as an unresolvable error when contradicting a configuration allow (ref-archlint-006) governs multi-source rule reconciliation.

description: Investigate an architectural boundary finding reported between two declared business domains when the underlying layer dependency check already permits the import.

change_context.other_context: A cross-domain package reference compiles and passes ordinary layer rules, but domain boundary analysis flags an encapsulation issue between the two functional contexts.

human_notes: Single: Rule flagging cross-context imports targeting non-public layers as bounded-context breaches regardless of layer-level allowances (ref-archlint-010) governs domain boundary enforcement.

description: Investigate why runtime service interactions such as cross-domain database queries are not detected by architectural boundary analysis.

change_context.other_context: A team observes that service components interact dynamically during runtime execution but static analysis passes without reporting dependency edges.

human_notes: Single: Boundary decision establishing that Archlint operates strictly on the static import graph while runtime-trace correlation is deferred to a future phase (ref-archlint-012) governs analyzing dynamic execution dependencies.

description: Investigate why imports referencing external third-party libraries and standard packages do not appear in the architecture dependency graph.

change_context.other_context: Verify dependency graph construction when scanning source code containing external module imports that do not resolve to local repository paths.

human_notes: Single: Graph construction filtering rules that silently skip unresolvable external imports and non-governed source files (ref-archlint-015) govern dependency graph omissions.

description: Run architecture metrics analysis with default options on a codebase containing unstable dependency directions to inspect coupling metrics.

change_context.other_context: Execute the metrics tool using standard flags against an import graph that exhibits instability metric imbalances to observe the process outcome.

human_notes: Single: Contradictory authority where README claims default metrics runs are purely observational and always exit 0 while CLI implementation defaults --fail-on-violation to true and exits 1 on SDP violations (ref-archlint-014) governs default metrics execution.

description: Trace an architectural boundary violation back from the offending import location to the policy source that disallowed the dependency.

change_context.other_context: An engineer investigating a reported import violation needs diagnostic provenance to identify the specific architectural decision that introduced the boundary constraint.

human_notes: Single: Violation data model storing importing source file and line with the disallowing ADR file path as source attribution (ref-archlint-018) governs violation provenance reporting.
